owns: terminal Communication summary and orphan-content housekeeping
does_not_own: external PST/OST content or external mail-store mutation
separations: Source Scope identity is not filesystem path identity.
Canonical Communication identity is not entity-link identity.
Entity link is not domain ownership or domain lifecycle state.
Proposal acceptance is not source-message mutation.
MSG draft is not observed sent Communication.
Orphan purge is reconstructable-content minimization, not operational-domain deletion.
external_boundary: PST/OST stores are treated as read-only external evidence. Beta 1.0 performs no SMTP/Exchange/Graph/IMAP operations and never sends, receives, deletes, moves, marks or edits external mail items.
